_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-18 02:41:05Z)**_

Looking at the code, `copyAsPng` already exists as `actionCopyAsPng` in `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionClipboard.tsx:192`, and it calls `exportCanvas("clipboard", ...)` with `...appState` spread in — so it just inherits whatever `exportBackground` is currently set to. There's no way to force transparency independent of that setting today.

Recommended approach: add a second action, e.g. `actionCopyAsPngTransparent`, that's a near-copy of `actionCopyAsPng` but overrides `exportBackground: false` in the config object passed to `exportCanvas`, then register it in the element context menu (`App.tsx:13017`/`13036`) right next to the existing `actionCopyAsPng`/`actionCopyAsSvg` entries, plus add its label to `en.json` and an icon in `components/icons.tsx`. The main tradeoff: this adds a permanent extra menu entry for everyone (slightly more menu clutter) versus the alternative of just reusing the existing action with a temporary appState override — but a dedicated action is more discoverable and matches how `copyAsSvg` is already split out as its own menu item.

Want me to implement it that way?
